question: In his prayer, why did Elijah ask the LORD to answer him?
options: So that Elijah would become king
So that Ahab would give him gold
So that the rain would stop
So the people would know the LORD is God and that He was turning their hearts back
explanation: Elijah prayed, "Answer me, LORD, so these people will know that you, LORD, are God, and that you are turning their hearts back again."
